[[File:PX-74_Artillery_Droid.png|thumb|right|150px|A PX-74 Artillery Droid]]
'''PX-74 Artillery Droid''' was the [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droid]] units of the [[New Empire]] under the rule of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]], they were nearly twelve [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height and armed with two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] attached to their heads while using clawed legs to strike at enemies for close range combat.<ref name="False Emperor">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref>
